label: 📧 Validate email
description: Validate email-address syntax (RFC 5322) and optionally check the domain has MX records (DNS lookup). Adds `email_valid` boolean and `email_normalized` (lowercase + IDN-decoded local part) columns.

check_dns.label: Check DNS for MX records
check_dns.help: Slower (~50ms per unique domain) but catches typos like @gmial.com.
